choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the paper uses Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5.2 as parallel judges, without naming a primary judge or prioritizing one in the abstract or introduction. All three evaluate the same final stories with the same rubric, sample, arms, timing, and pairwise analysis; none supplies statistics or data_stats allowing a participant-level standardized effect, and the remaining rules do not distinguish them.

choices.quote: In the content analysis, we used three different LLM models (Claude, Gemini, and GPT) to evaluate the content, all with the same prompt.
